# Nevixa Pharma

> Nevixa Pharma is an Indian pharmaceutical marketing and distribution company based in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Its website provides a corporate profile and healthcare product catalogue for healthcare professionals, pharmacies and medical stores, distributors and stockists, hospitals and healthcare organizations, prospective customers, and business visitors.

## Company

- Company: Nevixa Pharma
- Business model: Pharmaceutical marketing and distribution
- Location: Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
- Website: https://nevixapharma.com
- Email: info@nevixapharma.com
- Industry: Pharmaceutical marketing and distribution
- Website purpose: Corporate profile, healthcare product catalogue, product discovery, product information, contact, WhatsApp enquiries, and lead generation.

## Product Divisions

Nevixa Pharma's catalogue is organized into four primary divisions:

- **Derma** — Dermatology and scalp-care products.
- **Cosmo** — Cosmetology and skin-wellness products.
- **Pedia** — Products for pediatric healthcare requirements.
- **General** — Products supporting general healthcare requirements across multiple therapeutic areas.

## Website

The website includes:

- Home
- About
- Products
- Product Details
- Derma division
- Cosmo division

- General division
- Contact

Key URLs:

## Product Catalogue

The product catalogue supports:

- Division/category browsing

Product detail pages can include:

- Product name

## WhatsApp Enquiries

The website supports product-specific WhatsApp enquiries.

Preferred message format:

> Hello Nevixa Pharma, I would like to enquire about [Product Name].

The product name should be inserted dynamically according to the selected product.

## Business Scope

Nevixa Pharma is presented as a pharmaceutical marketing and distribution company, not as a pharmaceutical manufacturer.

The website is a corporate and healthcare product-catalogue platform, not an online pharmacy.

The following are outside the stated website scope:

- Pharmaceutical manufacturing sections
- PCD/franchise functionality
- Franchise management
- Distributor-partnership application systems
- E-commerce
- Online payments
- Customer accounts
- Prescription processing
- Medical consultation
- Backend/database functionality unless separately agreed
- Admin panel/CMS unless separately agreed

## Target Audience

- Doctors and healthcare professionals
- Pharmacies and medical stores
- Distributors and stockists
- Hospitals and healthcare organizations
- Prospective customers
- Business visitors
